scope: Real local PostgreSQL group-message pin persistence, membership, limit and concurrent-writer verification; not full product acceptance.

environment.isolation: New disposable --rm container, tmpfs database storage, generated test-only credential, loopback-only 127.0.0.1:15432 binding, no host data mount or user database.
environment.migration_path: The existing newPostgresTestDB helper creates a separate local hichat_test_* schema per test and runs the embedded PostgreSQL migration set, including 037_group_dm_pins.sql.

tests: TestGroupPinsCapAtomicIdempotenceAndUnpin: five passes; eight concurrent writers compete for the final slot, exactly one succeeds; fifty-pin limit, idempotence at cap, unpin/free-slot reuse and non-truncation of legacy fifty-one-pin records.

TestGroupPinsPersistAndRequireCurrentMembership: five passes; durable ciphertext-preserving list, outsider and cross-group denial, revoked-member list/unpin denial, idempotent unpin and deleted-message removal.

cleanup.details: The command's finally block restored its process-local test DSN and stopped only the named disposable container. Docker --rm removed it; a separate docker ps -a name check returned no row. No persistent test volume was created.

remaining: Real two-client encrypted group pin/expression UI acceptance and Windows/web device/visual acceptance remain pending.
No claim is made about the full repository suite on PostgreSQL, other P0-P11 requirements, deployment or release readiness.
release: No commit, push, merge, production migration, deployment or publication.
